lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the HARC public hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple large-scale buildings in Backman Village going through preliminary design review on Tuesday. That same day, the Board of County Commissioners takes up two Land Use Code amendments, including new rules for natural medicine businesses and nonconforming lots. San Miguel County also holds its sixth working session on the housing code rewrite Wednesday, moving closer to final redline recommendations on zoning, density, and workforce housing incentives.
